VERITY 1.2.2 adds approval controls for updates and file sharing.

- VERITY asks before downloading and installing a newly detected update.
- Use the conversation paperclip to choose up to five files to share with the AI. VERITY extracts their text locally and sends up to 8,000 characters per file to NOVA with AI questions until you remove them or quit the app.
- Selected file snapshots can be removed at any time; remove and reselect a file to refresh it.

Older versions may install this update automatically if their automatic installation setting is enabled. Once 1.2.2 is installed, future updates require approval.

Download the DMG, open it, and drag VERITY.app into Applications.
